scripts.check: npm run svelte-check && npm run clippy
scripts.lint: npm run eslint && npm run prettier && npm run rustfmt
scripts.fmt: npm run fmt -w ui && prettier --write scripts .github eslint.config.ts codecov.yml && cargo fmt --all
scripts.test: npm run vitest && npm run cargo-test && npm run stale-bindings
scripts.bench: cargo bench -p tsugiki-core && npm run bench -w ui
scripts.eslint: npm run eslint -w ui && eslint scripts eslint.config.ts
scripts.prettier: npm run prettier -w ui && prettier --check scripts .github eslint.config.ts codecov.yml
